We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template (ID 1914385) to the molecule given: initial_molecule SMILES: COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O

We have template search result: mapped_rxn and template_id. The mapped_rxn is a reaction SMILES with atom mapping. The template ID is 1914385. We need to apply this template to the target molecule (the initial molecule). Use apply_template tool with molecule_smiles and template_id.

We need to get list of precursor combinations (list of lists). Use apply_template.

Let's call apply_template with molecule_smiles = "COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O" and template_id = "1914385". Note template_id expects string.
